svg.title: CdSe/ZnSe particles for annealing film
svg.desc: Particles with reported [ZnSe/CdSe]=2.5 deposited from solution for the annealing comparison. This is distinct from a ZnSe-matrix ES-OMCVD film. The 400/450 °C source conflict and pre/post-anneal state are retained in the record, not resolved by this card.
